To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the attitudes of the customer towards shopping online, the product/service attributes, and the online store attributes, are important factors which affect the preference of online shopping.

(1) customers' attitudes towards online shopping, product/service attributes, and online stores' attributes are the most important factors that influence customers' preference for online shopping; (2) customers' attitudes, product/service attributes and online stores' characteristics are interdependent; and (3) customers' attitudes are the most important determinant of customers' preference for shopping online.
online shopping preference depends on customers' attitudes, product attributes, and online shopping store attributes.
